questions.q: Which snack gives you long-lasting energy for school and play?
questions.note: Fruit plus protein is a power-team for steady energy that lasts for hours!

questions.q: Why do we call a healthy meal a 'Rainbow Plate'?
options: Different food colors give different vitamins
The plate is painted like a rainbow
It only has skittles on it
questions.note: Red, orange, green, purple, and white whole foods each carry unique nutrients!

questions.q: What is the best everyday drink for your brain and muscles?
questions.note: Water hydrates your body and brain so you can run fast and think clearly.

questions.q: Which mineral in milk, cheese, and yogurt builds strong bones and teeth?
questions.note: Calcium teams up with Vitamin D to make your growing bones and teeth super strong!

questions.q: What superpower do orange veggies like carrots and sweet potatoes have?
questions.note: Orange veggies are rich in beta-carotene (Vitamin A), which helps your eyes see clearly!

questions.q: Why are whole grains like oatmeal and brown rice great for breakfast?
questions.note: Whole grains have fiber and B-vitamins that fuel your brain all morning long!

questions.q: Which vitamin in oranges, strawberries, and bell peppers helps fight off colds?
questions.note: Vitamin C is an immune-system superhero that helps your body heal and stay healthy!

questions.q: Which food group acts like building blocks to repair and grow your muscles?
options: Proteins like eggs, chicken, fish, and beans
questions.note: Proteins are made of amino acids that build strong muscles and help you grow taller!

questions.q: What helpful nutrient in apples, berries, and broccoli keeps your tummy happy?
questions.note: Fiber helps your digestion work smoothly and keeps you feeling full and satisfied!

questions.q: Why are blueberries and purple grapes called 'Brain Berries'?
options: Their antioxidants help memory and focus
questions.note: Blue and purple fruits contain anthocyanins that protect brain cells and boost memory!

questions.q: What mineral in spinach, lentils, and lean meat helps carry oxygen in your blood?
questions.note: Iron carries fresh oxygen from your lungs to your muscles and brain so you don't feel tired!

questions.q: Which nutrient in bananas helps stop muscle cramps when you run and play?
questions.note: Bananas are famous for potassium, an electrolyte mineral that keeps muscles and hearts happy!

questions.q: What are the friendly tiny helpers inside yogurt that help your digestion?
questions.note: Probiotics are friendly good bacteria that live in your tummy and help digest food!

questions.q: Which of these is a plant-based protein superhero?
questions.note: Beans, lentils, chickpeas, nuts, and tofu pack awesome protein plus tummy-friendly fiber!

questions.q: How much of your brain's daily energy comes from the food you eat?
questions.note: Your brain is always thinking and learning, so it uses about 20% of all your body's fuel!

questions.q: Why is it better to eat a whole orange instead of drinking orange-flavored soda?
options: Real fruit has natural fiber and Vitamin C without extra sugar
questions.note: Whole fruits keep their natural fiber and vitamins, giving you smooth energy without a sugar crash!

questions.q: Which green vegetable looks like a tiny tree and has more Vitamin C per gram than an orange?
questions.note: Broccoli florets look like little trees and are packed with Vitamin C, Vitamin K, and fiber!

questions.q: What do red fruits and veggies like tomatoes and watermelon have that helps your heart?
questions.note: Lycopene gives tomatoes and watermelons their bright red color and helps keep your heart strong!

questions.q: Which vitamin works as Calcium's best friend to help your bones absorb strength?
questions.note: Vitamin D from fortified milk, eggs, fish, and safe sunshine helps calcium lock into your bones!

questions.q: What happens when you eat 'sometimes treats' like cookies or candy on an empty stomach?
options: A quick sugar spike followed by a sleepy crash
questions.note: Sugary treats burn up super fast! Pairing snacks with protein or fiber keeps your energy steady.

questions.q: Which fish nutrient is famous for helping kids' brains and eyes grow super sharp?
questions.note: Salmon, tuna, and sardines have Omega-3 fatty acids that build healthy brain connections!

questions.q: Which of these snacks is a whole grain?
questions.note: Popcorn is actually a whole grain corn kernel! Lightly seasoned popcorn has plenty of fiber.

questions.q: Why does chewing your food slowly help your body?
options: It helps your tummy digest nutrients easily and notice when you're full
questions.note: Digestion starts in your mouth! Chewing well helps your stomach unlock every vitamin.

questions.q: Which fruit is about 92% water and helps keep you hydrated on a hot sunny day?
questions.note: Watermelon, strawberries, and cucumbers are packed with refreshing water and vitamins!

questions.q: What vitamin in leafy greens like spinach and kale helps your skin heal when you get a scrape?
questions.note: Vitamin K helps your blood clot when you get a tiny scrape so your skin can heal fast!

questions.q: What is a smart way to build a balanced plate for lunch or dinner?
options: Half fruits & veggies, a quarter whole grains, and a quarter protein
questions.note: Filling half your plate with colorful fruits and veggies gives you vitamins, fiber, and steady energy!

questions.q: Which of these breakfast foods gives you strong protein to start the morning?
questions.note: Eggs pack complete protein, choline for your brain, and Vitamin D for your bones!

questions.q: What color were the very first carrots grown by farmers hundreds of years ago?
questions.note: Ancient carrots were purple and yellow before orange carrots became popular—and purple carrots still exist!

questions.q: Why do athletes eat carbohydrates like brown rice, pasta, or bananas before a big game?
options: Carbohydrates store quick-access fuel in your muscles
So they don't need to drink water
questions.note: Healthy carbs are your body's favorite fuel tank for running, jumping, and playing sports!

questions.q: Which creamy green fruit is packed with healthy fats that help your body absorb vitamins?
questions.note: Avocados are a fruit rich in heart-healthy fats, fiber, and potassium!

miniChallenge.title: Rainbow Kitchen Quest
miniChallenge.description: Find three different food colors in your kitchen or meal today and check them off!

didYouKnow.title: Did you know?
didYouKnow.fact: Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not botanically berries!
